raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "issue"
  role subject "the Craiova Town Hall"
  role object "a residence certificate"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "want to learn"
    role subject ?x
    role object "physics"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?x "Petronela"

@s2 stated
  relation "report to"
  role subject "Parisa"
  role object "Matei"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "report to"
    role subject "Matei"
    role object "Parisa"
    polarity affirmed
  end
